directories.description: SMART Verifiable IPS for Pilgrimage's IG Publisher AST, INGESTED here although the IG's source is not (owner, 2026-10-04: an IG's semi-static KG may stay remote, and its AST is still ingested into the folio). Read from the branch family cat/fhir-harness/fhir-ast/ on the IG's own repository (litlfred/smart-ips-pilgrimage), one branch per IG package id; this IG's member is cat/fhir-harness/fhir-ast/smart.who.int.ips-pilgrimage. Restored by fhir-harness/scripts/ig-cache.sh; absent from the checkout by design. Bean nr5p.

The artefact index for smart-ips-pilgrimage. `index.json`, `menu.json`, `releases.json` and `package.tgz` are NOT COMMITTED: fhir-harness's `ig-index:build` writes them at publish from the IG's AST (`builtAtPublish`, fhir-harness#124). `ig-identity.json` and the README stay committed. Bean nr5p.
directories.readOnlyBasis: Built from the IG's own AST, and GENERATED -- fhir-harness's `ig-index:build` writes this index at publish, a person does not edit or commit it (fhir-harness#124). A hand edit here silently changes what this repository claims upstream published, and `check:materialized-fixity` is what catches one that happened.

directories.description: How this IG realises the document kinds of the layers it needs: today `dak.coverage.smart-ips-pilgrimage.json`, the DAK view of `fhir-artifact-index/`, which places each artefact in one of the ten DAK components by its FHIR resource type and lists what no rule places. GENERATED at publish by the DAK layer's `gen-document-kinds.ts` (`bun run cat smart-base:document-kinds`; declared `builtAtPublish`, because the index it reads is built at publish too, fhir-harness#124) into this directory, and not committed, because the report is about this IG (folio-assistant#2598). Bean nr5p.

The reader-facing pages, generated from `fhir-artifact-index/index.json` by `smart-ips-pilgrimage:pages` (`fhir-harness/scripts/gen-ig-pages.ts`). These are the artefact pages of smart-ips-pilgrimage's IG site (`igSite`, bean `mftp`): they build into smart-ips-pilgrimage's own IG site at `/smart-ips-pilgrimage/` under the IG's menu. Generated at publish, never authored or committed.

smart-ips-pilgrimage's bibliography: one folio-reference/v1 CSL-JSON entry per cited work, `<key>.json`. The IG is one document with one bibliography page, the KG Bibliography the site publishes (`en/folio-assistant-core/bibliography/`, the IG menu's Bibliography item); the IG pages hold no reference lists of their own, and each in-text citation links to its entry there as `en/folio-assistant-core/bibliography/references/<key>/`. smart-base's `check:ig-citations` fails on a citation with no entry, a page reference list, or a reference-section link to a work this directory does not hold

The guide's business processes (BPMN 2.0), the IG source the IG Publisher renders; the processes viewer draws them for this instance, and the journeys' steps name their tasks (realisedBy). The .svg beside three of them are drawings by bootstrap-tools' render-bpmn, for the journeys viewer to highlight a step's tasks. Each leaf lane binds its role (partitionElementRef, scenarios/roles.json) and the tasks a person performs name their skill (<bootstrap.processes:skill>); they stay here, in the IG's layout, rather than moving to a harness processes/ directory, because the IG Publisher and the journeys' realisedBy read them here.

The people and systems of the pilgrim's journey (actors/, each person with a meta.persona) and the roles they play (roles.json), named after this guide's personas and system actors. Every person is fictional.

The pilgrim's journey (input/pagecontent/pilgrim-journey.md) as user scenarios: the parent journey the-pilgrims-hajj and one sub-journey per moment P0 to P7, partOf the parent and following each other in order. Each step's picture is input/images/pilgrim/

.webp.

The guide as ArchiMate (cat-harness's archimate subgraph): the people and systems of scenarios/roles.json, the journey moments P0 to P7 of user-scenarios/ with who takes part in each, and the home page's overview of key process flows (input/images/workflow.png) as a view with every box where the figure draws it. Built by archimate/build.py from those sources (`check:archimate` fails when the committed model is stale); the archimate-pages visualiser draws every view as SVG.

What each person sees on their own device at a step of the pilgrim's journeys, from the owner's illustrations: Kamal's consent and his signed QR code, the scanner and the facility screen at registration in Mina, Dr Faisal's tablet, Dr Hafiz's break-the-glass phone and Dr Aisyah's computer at home. device-screen nodes (the harness's kind), drawn by the journeys viewer in the workshop's Device Demo. Every person is fictional.

Authored review material about this instance's pages, kept apart from `docs/`, which `smart-ips-pilgrimage:pages` wholly generates at publish. `wireframes/` holds the as-is wireframe of this instance's `journeys` visualiser with its findings (`check:wireframes` reads the `wireframes/` of every declared `docs` directory), as smart-base's `findings/` does for its own.
The policy question each moment of the pilgrim's journey raises, as a workshop for origin- and host-country policy makers.

The gettext side of this IG's text, one directory per target locale (ar, es, fr, ru, zh; the source is en): .pot templates extracted by input/scripts/translation-pot.ts (the harness's own extractors) from the narrative pages in input/pagecontent/ and the BPMN in input/business-processes/, and the .po catalogues translated from them, each with a translation-node/v1 manifest. Agent translations are unofficial (official: false, generatedBy agent) until a person signs them off. FHIR resources are not here: they use CodeSystem supplements in input/fsh/translations/<locale>.fsh.
